title: Publishing
selectBuild: Open a completed build and choose Publish to freeze a site version.
prepareHint: A plan freezes this build and target configuration. Nothing is published until you choose Publish this version.
attentionHint: An activation may have occurred. Inspect the target and receipt before publishing again. This job will not retry automatically.
expiredHint: Plans expire after 24 hours. Running jobs keep their frozen content until the outcome is known.
sourceUnavailable: The source or build is unavailable. Open a completed build and try again.
notFound: This publication is unavailable to your account.
conflict: The plan or execution state changed. Reload before continuing.
artifactInvalid: The build artifact failed verification. Build the site again.
unavailable: Publishing is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
historyFull: Publication history is full. Contact your administrator.
snapshotQuota: Frozen publication content has reached its storage limit. Cancel unused prepared plans.
planExpired: This plan expired. Prepare a new plan from a completed build.
targetBusy: Another publication is active or needs review for this destination.
alreadyStarted: Publishing has started. A running publication cannot be cancelled as though nothing happened.
snapshotUnavailable: Frozen content is unavailable. Prepare a new publication plan.
leaseLost: Another worker owns this publication. Refresh its status.
busy: Publication preparation is busy. Please try again shortly.
connectionChanged: The connection was changed or disabled. Prepare a new plan after reviewing it.
siteUrlMismatch: The build URL and base path do not match the connection URL. Rebuild for this destination.
deliveryFailed: Publication failed. Check target availability and permissions.
targetChanged: The destination no longer matches the managed release. Inspect it before continuing.
targetQuota: The destination reached its release or storage limit. Archive old releases before publishing again.
crossOrigin: This publication request has an invalid origin.
outcomeUnknown: The destination does not prove this release is live. Inspect it before starting another publication.
localVerification: The site files are active. Configure your web server to serve this directory; the public URL has not been checked.
remoteRecoveryHint: Recovery only removes this plan’s lock after verifying that its exact files are already active. It never uploads again or switches the live version. If activation cannot be proved, operator review is required.
remoteVerification: The remote files and current link were verified. Public URL reachability was not checked.
remoteLocked: This remote site has a publication lock. Reconcile the owning job before publishing another version.
remoteOutcomeUnresolved: The remote outcome cannot be proved. No activation was replayed. Inspect the server before resolving this job.
remoteTargetChanged: The remote target or release was changed outside this plan. Review it before continuing.
remoteTargetQuota: The remote target reached its release, file or size limit. Review retained files before preparing another publication.
remoteCredentialUnavailable: SFTP credentials could not be read. Check the connection and its encryption key.
remoteConnectionFailed: Could not connect to the SFTP server. Check the address, port and network.
remoteHostKeyMismatch: The server host key does not match the trusted fingerprint. No credentials were sent. Verify the server identity.
remoteAuthenticationFailed: The SFTP server rejected authentication. Check the username and credentials.
remoteDisconnected: The SFTP connection was interrupted or exceeded its time limit.
remotePermissionDenied: The SSH account cannot access this directory.
remoteUnsupported: This server lacks the required atomic publication capabilities. Use a compatible SFTP server or export the site for manual deployment.
remoteInvalidRemotePath: The remote directory contains unmanaged files, a symlink or another connection’s marker. Choose a dedicated empty directory.
remoteOperationFailed: The SFTP server could not complete the directory operation. Check permissions and server capabilities.
remoteNotFound: A required remote file or directory is missing.
